items.html: But in the Klipot of Atzilut, where there was no correction except in ZON, which are Esau and his wife, therefore all these hairs that were here in Aba and Ima of holiness are there in Esau, who is ZA of the Klipot, and moreover they are red like a rose. And this is the reason that he emerged ruddy and entirely like a hairy mantle. And these are the aspect of those four hundred men, who are opposite the hairs of holiness, which are four corrections, and they are four hundred men, as is mentioned by us.
